Mrs. Tranter hosted [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) when they visited her to resolve a mix-up regarding Nell's adoption. ## Relationships

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/thirza-abernethy--tranter.md)

Tranter and [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) are acquaintances who interact when consulting on orphan placement. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit Tranter in [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) in order to arrange the girl's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) following an adoption mix-up, though the matter is ultimately delayed when another local woman offers to take the child. They later remain connected as mutual acquaintances within the community through subsequent events.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), +9 more_

- Friend of — acquaintances visiting and consulting on orphan placement  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003)</sub>
